surface_mechanism_description: Reduction of CoCp2 by NH3 plasma and CoSi2 formation by SiH4 plasma simultaneously occur on a surface accompanying with CVD reaction of NH3 and SiH4 plasma.
evidence: In addition, no CoSi2 was deposited by PE-ALD from CoCp2 and SiH4 plasma without NH3 in our separate experiment, indicating that the formation of CoSi2 requires the reduction of CoCp2 by NH3 plasma at our process conditions. Therefore, the gas phase CVD reaction of NH3 plasma and SiH4 occurred more dominantly than the surface reaction of CoCp2 by NH3 plasma with increasing SiH4 flow leading to decrease in areal density.
